CS3230 is independent of these chains except for the mutual exclusion with CS3235. The student has 8 courses left: CS2100, CS2106, CS2102, CS4212, CS3219, CS3230, CS3235, CS2101. All are 4 MC. Total 32 MC. Semesters available: Y2S1 (5), Y2S2 (6), Y3S1 (7). Y3S2 is exchange (0 MC). Y4S1 (8), Y4S2 (9? No, max 8). Wait, Y3S2 is semester 6? So available semesters for coursework: 3, 4, 5, 7, 8. That is 5 semesters. Limit 4 MC per semester. Max MC = 20. Required MC = 32. 32 > 20. Impossible."]
